content.comment_body: Hello, I'm aiming to use both 12VDC and 230VAC as digital inputs in the same program to control 230VAC 10A output relays. What is the recommended [product_name] setup for this task? If it matters, I can switch the 12VDC signal to 24VAC/DC. I currently have a [product_name] [article_no].

With a [product_name] [article_no], you cannot connect 230VAC signals directly. Similarly, there are no 230VAC expansion modules available. You need to isolate 230VAC signals using coupling relays or optocouplers.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have encountered constraints with [product_name] [article_no] when trying to use both low (12VDC/24VAC/DC) and high (230VAC) voltage signals as digital inputs. Replies clarify that direct high voltage input is not supported, signifying a lack of product flexibility and a need for external interfacing components. The discussion focuses on compatibility and increased configuration complexity due to hardware limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] [article_no] to support both low and high voltage input signals natively or to provide integrated options for combining different signal types in a single installation.
